title: Qantas Airbus A350-1000ULR sets world-record longest commercial flight
caption:
Qantas just broke the world record for the longest commercial flight, traveling over 14,000 miles non-stop. This modified Airbus A350 stayed in the air for over 24 hours to prove that direct flights from Australia to London are finally possible.

Source: Newatlas - Qantas Airbus A350-1000ULR sets world-record longest commercial flight
